reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import math
for ang in [45,-45]:
 pts=[]
 for r,c in M:
  x=c-1.5;y=r-1
  a=math.radians(ang)
  # standard cartesian x right, y up (invert row)
  Y=-y
  xx=x*math.cos(a)-Y*math.sin(a); yy=x*math.sin(a)+Y*math.cos(a)
  pts.append((round(-yy),round(xx)))
 mi=min(r for r,c in pts); mj=min(c for r,c in pts)
 out={(r-mi,c-mj) for r,c in pts}
 print(ang, sorted(out), (max(r for r,c in out)+1,max(c for r,c in out)+1))

import math
# all rasterized rotation variants: center bbox, centroid, rounding and floor variants
Mcoords=list(M)
for centername in ['bbox','centroid']:
 if centername=='bbox': cr=(min(r for r,c in M)+max(r for r,c in M))/2; cc=(min(c for r,c in M)+max(c for r,c in M))/2
 else: cr=sum(r for r,c in M)/len(M); cc=sum(c for r,c in M)/len(M)
 for ang in [45,-45]:
  pts=[]
  for r,c in M:
   x=c-cc; y=-(r-cr); a=math.radians(ang)
   xx=x*math.cos(a)-y*math.sin(a); yy=x*math.sin(a)+y*math.cos(a)
   pts.append((-yy+cr,xx+cc))
  for method in ['round','floor','ceil']:
   f={'round':round,'floor':math.floor,'ceil':math.ceil}[method]
   ints=[(int(f(r)),int(f(c))) for r,c in pts]
   mi=min(r for r,c in ints); mj=min(c for r,c in ints)
   shp=frozenset((r-mi,c-mj) for r,c in ints)
   vline=max(sum(1 for r,c in shp if c==j) for j in range(6))
